domains.title: Company websites
domains.description: Domains or URLs, e.g. hubspot.com, https://www.calendly.com. Each returns the people on its team/about pages with titles and emails, and every email published on the site.

people.title: People to look up
people.description: One per line: first and last name, then the company domain, e.g. "Jane Doe, acme.com". Returns that person's most likely email, with confidence.

onlyDecisionMakers.title: Only decision-makers
onlyDecisionMakers.description: Keep only founders, C-level, presidents, VPs, heads of, directors, partners and owners. Published generic emails (info@, sales@...) are left out too.

includeGenericEmails.title: Include generic emails
includeGenericEmails.description: Also return role inboxes found on the site (info@, sales@, press@, support@...).

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerDomain.description: How many pages to read per site (homepage, team, about, leadership, contact...). More pages find more people on large sites.

maxResultsPerDomain.title: Maximum contacts per website
maxResultsPerDomain.description: Stop after this many people and emails per site. Decision-makers come first.
